probes.name: compare-list-new-and-previous
probes.reason: Previous comparisons list (ComparisonList / PreviousComparisonsSection) is component-built and unit-tested; verified unmounted in live Compare workspace shell pending root-level integration.

probes.name: reload-rank-result-reconstruction
probes.reason: Direct-loaded Rank result reconstructs recommendation, leaderboard, scores, consensus, ad hoc badge, exploratory evidence receipt, exact Record link, and Open in Compare from persisted state with zero provider calls.

probes.name: reload-fuse-result-reconstruction
probes.reason: Direct-loaded Fuse result reconstructs the fused document output and ad hoc badge from persisted state.

probes.name: interrupted-recovery-state
probes.reason: Interrupted comparison result renders an explicit interrupted notice; completed candidate outputs are preserved.

probes.name: canonical-task-binding
probes.reason: Canonically-bound result renders canonical Task badge linking to the exact version route and canonical evidence receipt.

probes.name: missing-source-state
probes.reason: Comparison index without a source run record renders an explicit missing-source state, never a fabricated merged result.

probes.name: exact-record-drilldown
probes.reason: View exact Record navigates to the immutable run detail (data-run-detail) showing the task excerpt, with an Open in Compare continuity action back to the owning workspace.

probes.name: return-to-owner
probes.reason: Open in Compare returns from the exact Record to the Compare owner workspace.

probes.name: promote-link-dialog-surface
probes.reason: PromoteComparisonTaskDialog (spec §7.3) is component-built and unit-tested; verified unmounted in live result route pending root-level modal wiring.

probes.name: canonical-edit-version-choice-surface
probes.reason: ComparisonTaskBindingControl (spec §7.2) is component-built and unit-tested; verified unmounted in live Compare command pane pending root-level command wiring.

probes.name: mobile-390-viewport
probes.reason: 390px mobile result route has no horizontal overflow, no crushed title, and primary actions (View exact Record, Back to Compare) remain reachable.

probes.name: tablet-768-viewport
probes.reason: 768px tablet boundary renders the result route without horizontal overflow.

probes.name: zoom-200-percent
probes.reason: 200% zoom at 1440px renders the result route without horizontal overflow and preserves the recommendation surface.

probes.name: keyboard-record-link-activation
probes.reason: Keyboard focus reaches the View exact Record link and Enter activates navigation to the run detail.

probes.name: reduced-motion
probes.reason: Reduced-motion emulation renders the result route and recommendation surface without motion-dependent failure.

probes.name: long-fields-overflow
probes.reason: Long titles, prompts, and model slugs wrap without element-level or document-level horizontal overflow.

probes.name: secret-zero-leakage
probes.reason: Credential-shaped token seeded into the harness never leaks into the rendered DOM or body text.

probes.name: zero-provider-egress
probes.reason: Harness completed with zero external provider calls (100% intercepted and local).
